implementation: Original bounded standard-library TIFF, BigTIFF, CCITT fax and ICO/CUR implementation
tables: raster_fax.py contains the normative binary code-word assignments (format facts), not specification prose or upstream implementation code.
fixture_oracle: Pillow 12.1.1 using native libtiff and ICO decoders, and libtiff TIFFReadRGBAImageOriented for the valid big-endian BigTIFF unsupported by Pillow's IFD parser. Native libraries are used only to generate committed independent pixels, never at runtime or by tests.

TIFF custom YCbCr coefficients and reference black/white
TIFF CIELAB, LogL/LogLuv, JPEG 2000, JBIG, WebP and Zstandard compression
Old-style TIFF JPEG layouts lacking a complete JPEG stream
